verdict.rationale: The only evidence of export is a community user describing sharing collections by 'export/import JSON files', alongside first-party docs naming the Postman Collection format. Together these suggest collections can be exported as JSON. The Postman API's general asset management is a developer building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: first-party documentation of data export, coverage of all data types (environments, history, mocks, specs, test results, team data), confirmation the export formats are open, and a documented full-account export or exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: we've long waited for live collection sharing without needing everyone to export/import JSON files
use types in collections to design your API with the Postman Collection format
